checker: independent pcbnew readback against actual KiCad XML; no builder imported

warnings.note: A placement review is not a routed or fabrication-ready PCB.

pin_mapping.NC_policy: Every NC symbol pin must have a pad. XML singleton unconnected-* may be unnamed on PCB; no functional net may be unnamed.

external_DRC.note: External DRC result; freshness must be checked against this board revision.

footprint_bounds.method: pcbnew footprint bbox excluding text, compared with Edge.Cuts bbox and 8 outline sample points

courtyard.method: pcbnew cached native same-side courtyard polygon Boolean intersections

connectivity.count_source: Raw pcbnew GetUnconnectedCount(False); reported independently from CLI DRC unconnected_items.

scope_limit: Readback validates physical assignment and records layout/routing findings; electrical ratings, thermal design and manufacturability are not approved.
